islasso: The Induced Smoothed Lasso

Source: R/islasso-package.R
islasso-package.Rd

Estimation and inference for lasso and elastic-net regularised regression models through the induced smoothing approach: the non-smooth penalty is replaced by its expectation under the approximate sampling distribution of the estimator, so that standard errors (sandwich formula) and Wald tests are available for all the coefficients.

Details

Main functions: [islasso()] fits a model at a given value of the tuning parameter (chosen by cross-validation if missing), [islasso.path()] fits a regularisation path, with [GoF.islasso.path()] and [aic.islasso()] selecting the tuning parameter by information criteria; [relax.islasso()] refits a relaxed model. Methods for [summary()][summary.islasso], [confint()][confint.islasso], [anova()][anova.islasso] (general linear hypotheses), [predict()][predict.islasso] and [plot()][plot.islasso] are available.

References

Cilluffo G., Sottile G., La Grutta S., Muggeo V.M.R. (2020). The induced smoothed lasso: a practical framework for hypothesis testing in high dimensional regression. *Statistical Methods in Medical Research*, **29**(3), 765–777. doi:10.1177/0962280219842890

Sottile G., Cilluffo G., Muggeo V.M.R. (2019). The R package islasso: estimation and hypothesis testing in lasso regression. Technical report. doi:10.13140/RG.2.2.16360.11521
